agent: Codex through existing service; exact model build and inference hardware unavailable
agent_roles: lead evidence extraction and report editing
separate result and artifact reviewers, recorded in their reviews
browser: Chrome through the supported computer-use interface; exact installed browser version not recorded
browser_interaction: Visible DOM controls and task-region screenshots. No injected website code or direct experiment write APIs. Post-decision Calendar audit uses a read-only connector.

seed_scope: Assignment order only, not model or website timing.
